summary: auth login --chrome no longer hard-requires the short-lived `auth` cookie. It requires the long-lived signed-in cookies (CID, SPID, customer); with them and a live `auth` it reports the session as active with its expiry, with them but no live `auth` it imports and warns that the session must be renewed by opening walmart.com, and without them it refuses the session as anonymous. Profile discovery ranks on CID/SPID.
reason: Walmart's `auth` cookie lives about 30 minutes and is renewed by site activity from the identity.walmart.com session; an idle but signed-in browser has no `auth` row, which made login fail even though the account was signed in.
validated_outcome: Synthetic tests cover active, lapsed and anonymous sessions (including a stray auth cookie without signed-in cookies). Live 2026-10-09 11:25 CT: import reported an active session; cart view PASS.
